title: Aeroships
description: Helpful mods for the Aeronautics mod.
body:
This modpack enhances the gameplay experience around the Aeronautics mod by adding visual improvements, immersion upgrades, and lightweight QoL additions — all without changing the core mechanics of Aeronautics.
It focuses on delivering a smoother, more atmospheric, and more visually engaging flight experience while keeping the original Aeronautics progression, balance, and mechanics fully intact. Every addition is carefully selected to support Aeronautics rather than overshadow it, ensuring that the mod remains the centerpiece of gameplay.

It is designed for players who want a more cinematic, atmospheric, and polished aeronautics experience while keeping the original gameplay intact.
Whether you enjoy exploring the skies, building advanced aircraft, or capturing cinematic footage, this modpack provides a refined environment that enhances visuals, clarity, and immersion without introducing unnecessary complexity or content bloat.

**Features**

- Enhanced Visuals 💻 — improved skies, shaders, lighting, and atmospheric effects for more cinematic flights. The world feels more alive with richer colors, smoother lighting transitions, and more realistic cloudscapes, making every takeoff and landing visually impressive.
(Mods: Iris Shaders)

- Performance Optimizations ⚡ — tweaks and lightweight mods to keep Aeronautics smooth even with visual upgrades. These improvements reduce stuttering, stabilize framerates, and ensure consistent performance during high‑speed flights, large builds, or multiplayer sessions.
(Mods: Sodium)

- Non‑intrusive Additions ✅ — no progression changes, no new mechanics, no content bloat. Instead, the pack focuses on small but meaningful quality‑of‑life improvements that enhance usability, navigation, and player awareness without altering the core Aeronautics experience.
(Mods: Simple Voice Chat, AppleSkin, Xaero's Minimap)

**For who is this Modpack**

Players who enjoy Aeronautics and want a more immersive world
Creators who want cinematic visuals for videos or screenshots
Anyone wanting enhancements without altering the core mod
Players who prefer lightweight, performance‑friendly modpacks
Servers that want a stable, visually enhanced Aeronautics experience without gameplay changes
Builders and explorers who want a more atmospheric world without adding new content or progression systems.

**Known Bugs**

_(none)_
